messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Canary error spike for inference/gateway-service (deployment: model-v3.1.0-canary)
- metric: canary-error-rate = 17.8% (baseline 0.3%)
- symptom: 502/504 + TokenizationError on decode
- example trace: trace=8c7b2f1e

deploy-bot: Deploy initiated: model-v3.1.0 -> canary (10% traffic) @1959876543

oncall_sre: paging alex, mae, sanjay. Alex is on-call for infra today.

alex: ACK. I'm investigating canary hosts and CGW routing. pinging ken for gateway metrics.

ken: seeing an uptick in downstream 502s for the canary pool. Attaching sample request IDs.

mae: logs show repeated exceptions: "TokenizationError: unknown token id 0xFFFF at pos 0"

sanjay: that points to tokenizer/weights mismatch — encoder expecting different vocab/merges.

alex: grabbing model bundle metadata from storage.

alex: sample model metadata on canary:
```
model_tag: model-v3.1.0
tokenizer_hash: afd12b (runtime accepted: 5d2c00)
weights_checksum: 9f45c3
```

alex: pausing canary traffic now.
alex: `/flag set routing.model_v3 0` (set traffic to v3.1.0 -> 0%)

ops-bot: feature-flag updated: routing.model_v3 = 0% by alex

deploy-bot: Canary routing paused. v3.1.0 receiving 0% traffic

mae: temporarily routing previous stable v3.0.9 for the affected routes.

lina: CS: tagging impacted accounts. Initial telemetry: 3 enterprise tenants saw 4-12% failures between 14:02-14:09 UTC. Crafting notice.

cs-ops: sending initial notification to affected customers (short summary + we are investigating).

alex: after pausing, 502s dropped back to baseline within ~70s. Gateway latency normalized.

sanjay: from pipeline logs, the model artifact was built against tokenizer v2.4 but the runtime uses v2.6 due to a registry mismatch (config drift in tokenizer registry reference).

mae: reproducing locally: loading the v3.1.0 bundle with the runtime causes immediate TokenizationError.
I'll open the bundle to inspect tokenizer.json and metadata.

alex: recommendation: unpublish the canary artifact and roll back to v3.0.9 until we fix pipeline validation.

deploy-bot: Rollback: untagging model-v3.1.0 canary, restoring active tag to model-v3.0.9. Rollback initiated @1959876660

alex: repointing live symlink from `s3://redwood-weights/model-v3.1.0/current` -> `s3://redwood-weights/model-v3.0.9/current`

mae: found root cause: CI job 7921 pulled tokenizer from the 'latest' pointer which pointed to an incompatible tokenizer after a manual update; no checksum guard was enforced.

mae: patching pipeline to verify tokenizer_hash in bundle matches runtime-accepted hashes; adding blocking gate in the publish job.

ops-bot: post-rollback canary-error-rate = 0.4% (expected noise). System stable.

lina: CS update sent: summary, apology, and mitigations. Offering follow-up calls for enterprise customers.

sanjay: root cause: release pipeline allowed publishing model bundles with mismatched tokenizer metadata (config drift / registry pointer issue). Not a runtime code bug.

alex: on-call handoff: I'll stay for 30m to monitor, then hand to mae for follow-ups and postmortem.

mae: follow-ups (action items):
- Add pre-publish checksum validation for tokenizer.json vs runtime manifest (blocking)
- Add CI smoke test that runs a decode/encode roundtrip in a runtime container for canary bundles
- Require explicit tokenizer_version field in artifact metadata; reject 'latest' pointer
- Add deploy-time quick verify that loads tokenizer in canary host prior to traffic shift

cs-ops: tracking customer comms and any escalations in support. No ongoing outages.

ops-bot: Incident status -> RESOLVED (canary paused and rollback completed) @1959877089 :white_check_mark:

alex: thanks all — postmortem to be authored by mae, alex, and sanjay. Scheduling incident review tomorrow.

mae: I'll open the PR for the tokenizer checksum guard today.

sanjay: +1 on the roundtrip smoke test. Also suggest a small canary validation that runs 10 short requests through the model before switching traffic.

lina: closing the loop with CS; will escalate if customers report residual errors. Good triage and fast rollback :thumbsup:

incident-bot: closing alert stream for thread 1959876543
